preconditions.description: The number of votes must be between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
Each vote must contain between 1 and 26 unique teams.

preconditions.expression: all(len(votes[i]) == len(votes[j]) for i in range(len(votes)) for j in range(i + 1, len(votes))
preconditions.description: All votes must have the same length.

preconditions.expression: all(char in votes[0] for vote in votes for char in vote)
preconditions.description: All characters in each vote must be present in the first vote.

preconditions.expression: all(char.isupper() for vote in votes for char in vote)
preconditions.description: All characters in each vote must be uppercase English letters.
All votes must contain unique characters.

postconditions.description: The result must be a string representing the sorted teams according to the ranking system.
